basis: All five pages of the current association_review_diagnostic.pdf were visually inspected after data generation. No published figure was consulted for these judgments.
selection: One example per predefined category, maximal pick count then lowest index; not a random accuracy sample.

findings.note: S-only picks lie well after visible onsets and major wave packets at several stations, including CPOZ. Possible coda mis-picks; no accepted origin or depth.
A coherent recorded onset is visible across several stations, while CSOC contributes an earlier S-before-P pair and CSTH an early isolated S. A real signal does not validate these assignments.

Clear coherent P and later horizontal wave packets occur on several stations, with another packet roughly ten seconds after the provisional origin. The lower-bound solution can accompany a real recorded event; this display does not validate zero depth.
Coherent energy starts before several assigned P marks, and the S marks lie in later energy. Late phase selection is plausible; the displayed signals do not establish an 8 km earthquake.
Many stations show clear P onsets and later larger horizontal arrivals near own picks. This supports a real recorded event qualitatively, but does not independently calibrate phase times or depth.
